reviews.text: Wonderful villa, and I especially loved emailing the agency four times before getting a reply. Very relaxing.
Their website still shows villas they stopped renting two years ago. Half the photos don't load on my phone.
[person] at the front desk was a star, sorted out our airport transfer in minutes. Can't recommend them enough!
Wanted to see prices before contacting them but there are no rates anywhere online. Everything is 'on request'.
Deposit had to be sent by international wire, no card option. Took a week and bank fees.
The owner replied to my review within a day and refunded the cleaning fee. Fair play.

reviews.evidence: Agency needed several emails before responding at all.
Site lists properties no longer offered and images fail on mobile.
Staff member arranged the transfer quickly; reviewer strongly recommends the agency.
Rental pricing is not published on the web; only given after asking.
Security deposit required a bank transfer without card payment, slow and costly.
